text:
sre-alert-bot: :rotating_light: hosted-usw2 GPU pool - metric-shedder activated. Shedding low-priority metrics to keep dashboard queries responsive. p95 queue depth > 95% for 4m. alert_id=MS-2026-05-12-01

maya: saw the alert. dashboards have gaps on heatmaps and per-pool telemetry. are we certain this is shedding and not an ingestion backend retry loop?

jon: we flipped the shedder to aggressive mode at 03:14 during the early spike. config: /ops/metric-shedder/usw2/config.yaml. key knobs: queue_p95=0.90, ingress_backlog_threshold=2000, min_window=120s.

lina: customers are noticing capacity charts missing points. can we relax it while we investigate?

alex: oncall here — rolling back mode to moderate now. ran: `curl -s -X POST https://infra-api/ops/metric-shedder/usw2/toggle -d '{"mode":"moderate"}'` and got 200.

maya: thanks. noticed admission token-bucket for low-priority traces also drained faster during the same window; seems shedder + token-bucket are compounding the signal loss.

jon: good catch. plan: make shedder metadata-aware so it skips metrics with admission-class: high|reserved. I'll open a PR with conservative defaults.

lina: while that's queued, can we add a banner to dashboards when shedder is active so product teams don't assume telemetry equals zero load?

ops-bot: deploy started for branch pr/2345 (jon/metric-shedder-guardrails). CI: ✅, e2e: running.

maya: target to land before next traffic window at 12:00 PST. also want a short retro note on cost vs visibility tradeoff.

alex: rollback finished at 1758204620; dashboard latency recovered and queries are back to normal. still seeing ~10% of low-priority metrics dropped (expected).

jon: i'll attach config diff and open the PR description with rationale. proposed changes: queue_p95 -> 0.95, min_window 120s -> 300s, and admission-class whitelist.

maya: also request: annotate historical dashboards with `shedder_active=true` so past incidents are explainable. shedding reduces storage/cost but can mask real capacity problems.

lina: agreed — show banner + add an alert rule when shedder flips state. make it loud but not page.

maya: great. jon, please ping when PR is merged and ops-bot when deploy completes. follow-up doc in eng-sre runbook for shedder tuning. :thumbsup:

jon: will do, filing PR and runbook patch now.

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded for pr/2345 at 1758204888.

maya: thanks team — closing the loop here. will schedule a short postmortem with infra and platform tomorrow. :calendar:
